preflight_correction: The v1 RSTB ternary control exposed 7.450580596923828e-09 optimal-MSE reprojection roundoff. V2 accepts only a four-epsilon FP32 bound and records both observed delta and tolerance.
hypothesis: A role-specific FP16 island trained from the exact hard-ternary state improves quality over a same-location hard-ternary control.

design.confirmation_gate: Run confirmation only when FP16 minus ternary has positive ground-truth paired-bootstrap lower 95% bound and no negative edge or teacher mean on the discovery seed.
design.optimizer_scope: AdamW is held fixed to isolate precision; optimizer variants are a later study only after a precision location survives.
